messages:
maya: Heads-up — bringing up MistralX-7B (converted via our llama3->mistral converter). Quick run with nf4 quant produced a weird token shift for long-context runs, and evals show a perf regression.
maya: Repro steps: `./convert --src llama3-7b --tgt mistralx-7b --fix-vocab` then start quant job `python quantize.py --mode=nf4 --per_layer_clip`. Local infer: `python serve_local.py --model mistralx-7b-q4`.
maya: Paste from logs: ```WARNING kv_cache: token_offset mismatch detected: expected 0..1023 got 5..1028
WARNING tokenizer: unknown token ids in mapping: [310, 311] -> [0, 1]
Perplexity: baseline=8.1, q4=14.7
``` 
raj: Hmm. token_offset mismatch smells like rotary/positional param mismatch, or our converter applied a global shift. Did converter use base_rotary=10000 or preserve original? :thinking:
evan: I ran a tiny loop earlier — MistralX uses rotary_scale in a different convention vs Llama3. If rotary base/scale differ we can see KV misalignment after a few tokens. Can you dump the rotary params? `python inspect_model.py --show-rotary`.
lisa: Also saw the unknown token ids. The tokenizer vocab mapping step in converter uses an `alias_map` if shapes differ; maybe our heuristic fell back to index-shift instead of canonical tokenization. Quick patch: force generator to emit `token_map.json` with explicit ids. I'll open PR.
garret: Ran a small eval suite (20 prompts) comparing baseline Llama3-7B -> mistralx-7b-q4. Results: MMLU-like micro avg down 6.4 pts, hallucination rate up ~8%, and response truncation in long completions (ctxt>512). Attaching CSV (link)
ci-bot: build #4821 — converter/infer tests failed on `eng-ml/mistralx` matrix (see https://ci.internal/build/4821) :x:
maya: Proposed immediate action: 1) pin tokenizer config to legacy mapping on serving side to avoid live regressions, 2) rollback any canary serving routes to Llama3-7B for affected customers, 3) run targeted per-layer quantization with power-of-two clip and rotary rescale patch.
raj: For workaround (1) we can add a small middleware that applies `token_map` remap before KV caching. Cheap and fast to deploy in dedicated infra. I'll prototype.
lisa: PR #679 added `--force-token-map` to converter and a rotary-rescale shim. Running a small matrix: nf4 vs nf4+rotary-fix + per-layer-clip. Will post numbers in ~30m.
evan: If rotary-rescale fixes the KV drift, we still need to audit other converted models (GemmaX, Qwen-lite) for the same mismatch. I can add an autotest to converter: run a round-trip tokenization/infer and check KV offsets for 2k steps.
garret: Agree. Also add a small eval alert to the rollout flow — if MMLU or hallucination metric changes >3 pts/percent we auto-stop the canary.
maya: Thanks — setting a short meeting in #eng-ml to coordinate rollback and PR review. @lisa @raj @evan please ping when matrix finishes. :thumbsup:
